name: QAILinks Denmark
description: QAILinks Denmark ApS is a Glostrup-based Danish subsidiary developing a hybrid quantum-AI orchestration platform targeting regulated healthcare data, confidential computing, federated learning workflows, and policy-driven governance. Incorporated as a Danish ApS on 2025-10-12 (CVR 46116720), the company is co-owned by founder Ali Daraeizadeh and parent QAILinks Technologies Corp, and is listed as a Danish Quantum Community and Quantum Denmark partner.
funding: Privately held; co-owned by founder Ali Daraeizadeh and parent QAILinks Technologies Corp
